remarks: Welcome to 146 Floss Ave, a charming and versatile 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home nestled in a desirable and friendly neighborhood. The spacious layout features two bedrooms upstairs with a bathroom and two additional bedrooms downstairs, along with a bright living room, formal dining area, large kitchen and a full bathroom. Recently refreshed with new paint and updated flooring, this home offers a comfortable blend of modern updates and timeless character. Generously sized bedrooms provide plenty of living space, while the full basement offers ample storage and potential for future customization. Outside, enjoy a private, spacious backyard and a large driveway with plenty of room for parking, relaxing, or entertaining. Conveniently located near schools, shopping, restaurants, and public transportation, this property is an excellent opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors looking for a home with strong rental potential. Don't miss the chance to make this wonderful property your own!
